name: Overwatch 2

scale.why: the game documents metres; heroes vary in size, so values are as given (not rescaled to 1.8 m)

speed.note: most heroes; Genji and Tracer 6 m/s; backwards -10%

gravity.source: https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/overwatch/t/fyi-how-to-counter-gravity/357645 (a Workshop 'start accelerating' up at 17.532 m/s2 cancels gravity)
gravity.note: found by Workshop users: the upward acceleration that holds a hero still in the air

jump.note: take-off speed for the wiki's 0.98 m jump at the Workshop-measured gravity: sqrt(2 x 17.532 x 0.98)

blinkDistance.note: Tracer's Blink: an instant teleport, not a burst; Quark's dash covers 2.84 m

blinkCooldown.note: between blinks; each charge recharges in 3 s (Quark's dash charge: 1.2 s)

grappleSpeed.note: pulls at a set speed, not an acceleration

extras: hero-specific movement abilities (blinks, dashes, wall-ride, jet packs, double jumps)
no air strafing to speak of
notes: Acceleration isn't documented. Gravity is the Workshop community's counter-gravity figure (17.532 m/s2), and the jump take-off speed is derived from it and the wiki's 0.98 m jump, so both are estimates of a kind. Tracer's Blink and Widowmaker's Grappling Hook are listed as facts: single heroes' abilities, not the game's movement.

sources.title: Overwatch Forums: how to counter gravity (Workshop)
